Data Setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtern)
library(lubridate)

scarp_sites <- c("FSV1", "BST1", "MPL1", "SRT1", "JPY1", "LSR1")
dip_sites   <- c("MCD1", "SCH1", "CHY1", "DFT1")

recent_data <- read.csv("data/FieldChemData.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    Mountain_Side = case_when(
      Site %in% scarp_sites ~ "Scarp",
      Site %in% dip_sites   ~ "Dip",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Period = "Recent"
  )

recent_element_cols <- names(recent_data)[
  !names(recent_data) %in% c("Site", "Date", "Mountain_Side", "Period")
]

recent_data <- recent_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(recent_element_cols),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", as.character(.x)))
  ))


early_data <- read_csv("data/MDH_Beast_AllChem_Apr22.csv") %>%
  filter(!Site %in% c("MSL", "MSTR1", "MSU", "RT0")) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = mdy(Date),
    Mountain_Side = case_when(
      Reach == "Beast" ~ "Scarp",
      Reach == "MDH"   ~ "Dip",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Period = "Earlier",
    Na = Na_ppb,
    Mg = Mg_ppb,
    Ca = Ca_ppb,
    Si = Si_ppb,
    Li = Li_ppb
  )


plot_data <- bind_rows(
  recent_data %>%
    select(Site, Date, Mountain_Side, Period, Ca, Li, Mg, Si, Na),
  early_data %>%
    select(Site, Date, Mountain_Side, Period, Ca, Li, Mg, Si, Na)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Mountain_Side = factor(Mountain_Side, levels = c("Scarp", "Dip")),
    Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Earlier", "Recent")),
    Side_Period = factor(
      paste(Mountain_Side, Period, sep = "_"),
      levels = c("Scarp_Earlier", "Scarp_Recent", "Dip_Earlier", "Dip_Recent")
    )
  )

poster_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

period_colors <- c(
  "Scarp_Earlier" = "#9B8AB9",
  "Scarp_Recent"  = "#6B5A8E",
  "Dip_Earlier"   = "#E39A63",
  "Dip_Recent"    = "#C76A2A"
)
```

Major Solute Concentrations
```{r}
poster_elements <- c("Ca", "Li", "Mg", "Si")

poster_long <- plot_data %>%
  select(Mountain_Side, Period, Side_Period, all_of(poster_elements)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(poster_elements),
    names_to = "Element",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Concentration), !is.na(Mountain_Side))

fig_A <- ggplot(
  poster_long,
  aes(
    x = Mountain_Side,
    y = Concentration,
    fill = Side_Period,
    group = interaction(Mountain_Side, Period)
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Element, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = period_colors,
    labels = c(
      "Scarp_Earlier" = "Scarp early",
      "Scarp_Recent"  = "Scarp recent",
      "Dip_Earlier"   = "Dip early",
      "Dip_Recent"    = "Dip recent"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major Solute Concentrations",
    x = "",
    y = "Concentration (ppb)"
  ) +
  poster_theme

print(fig_A)
```

Piper Plot
```{r}
piper_fig <- plot_data %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Ca),
    is.finite(Mg),
    is.finite(Na),
    !is.na(Side_Period)
  ) %>%
  ggtern(aes(
    x = Ca,
    y = Mg,
    z = Na,
    color = Side_Period
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Scarp_Earlier" = "#9B8AB9",
      "Scarp_Recent"  = "#6B5A8E",
      "Dip_Earlier"   = "#E39A63",
      "Dip_Recent"    = "#C76A2A"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Scarp_Earlier" = "Scarp early",
      "Scarp_Recent"  = "Scarp recent",
      "Dip_Earlier"   = "Dip early",
      "Dip_Recent"    = "Dip recent"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major Cation Composition",
    T = "Ca",
    L = "Mg",
    R = "Na"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    
    tern.axis.title.T = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    tern.axis.title.L = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    tern.axis.title.R = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    
    tern.axis.text.T = element_text(size = 18),
    tern.axis.text.L = element_text(size = 18),
    tern.axis.text.R = element_text(size = 18),
    
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  )

print(piper_fig)

ggsave("piper_fig.png", piper_fig,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```


Bulk Ratios
```{r}
ratio_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Mg_Ca = if_else(is.finite(Mg) & is.finite(Ca) & Ca > 0, Mg / Ca, NA_real_),
    Na_Ca = if_else(is.finite(Na) & is.finite(Ca) & Ca > 0, Na / Ca, NA_real_)
  )

ratio_df <- ratio_data %>%
  select(Mountain_Side, Period, Side_Period, Mg_Ca, Na_Ca) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Mg_Ca, Na_Ca),
    names_to = "Ratio",
    values_to = "Ratio_Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ratio = recode(Ratio,
      Mg_Ca = "Mg / Ca",
      Na_Ca = "Na / Ca"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ratio_Value), !is.na(Mountain_Side))

fig_ratios <- ggplot(
  ratio_df,
  aes(
    x = Mountain_Side,
    y = Ratio_Value,
    fill = Side_Period,
    group = interaction(Mountain_Side, Period)
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Ratio, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = period_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Bulk Ratios",
    x = "",
    y = "Molar ratio"
  ) +
  poster_theme

print(fig_ratios)
```

Magnesium/Sodium x Calcium/Sodium
```{r}
ratio_scatter <- plot_data %>% 
  mutate(
    Mg_Na = if_else(is.finite(Mg) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0, Mg / Na, NA_real_),
    Ca_Na = if_else(is.finite(Ca) & is.finite(Na) & Na > 0, Ca / Na, NA_real_)
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    is.finite(Mg_Na),
    is.finite(Ca_Na),
    !is.na(Mountain_Side)
  )

fig_ratio_scatter <- ggplot(
  ratio_scatter,
  aes(
    x = Ca_Na,
    y = Mg_Na,
    color = Side_Period
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Scarp_Earlier" = "#9B8AB9",
      "Scarp_Recent"  = "#6B5A8E",
      "Dip_Earlier"   = "#E39A63",
      "Dip_Recent"    = "#C76A2A"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Scarp_Earlier" = "Scarp early",
      "Scarp_Recent"  = "Scarp recent",
      "Dip_Earlier"   = "Dip early",
      "Dip_Recent"    = "Dip recent"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mg/Na vs Ca/Na",
    x = "Ca / Na",
    y = "Mg / Na"
  ) +
  poster_theme

print(fig_ratio_scatter)

ggsave("Fig_MgNa_vs_CaNa.png", fig_ratio_scatter,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
Discharge Comparison
```{r}
Qdat <- read_csv("data/mcd_beast_Q.csv")

# first, make sure datetime is actually parsed correctly
Qdat <- Qdat %>%
  mutate(datetime = parse_date_time(datetime,
                                    orders = c("mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy",
                                               "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd")))

discharge_long <- Qdat %>%
  select(datetime, Qmmd_mcd, Qmmd_beast) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Qmmd_mcd, Qmmd_beast),
    names_to = "Mountain_Side",
    values_to = "Discharge"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Mountain_Side = recode(
      Mountain_Side,
      Qmmd_beast = "Scarp",
      Qmmd_mcd   = "Dip"
    ),
    Window = case_when(
      datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-08-01") & datetime < as.POSIXct("2020-09-01") ~ "Early August 2020",
      datetime >= as.POSIXct("2020-10-25") & datetime < as.POSIXct("2020-12-01") ~ "Late Fall 2020",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Window)) %>%
  mutate(
    Window = factor(Window, levels = c("Early August 2020", "Late Fall 2020")),
    Mountain_Side = factor(Mountain_Side, levels = c("Scarp", "Dip"))
  )

fig_discharge <- ggplot(
  discharge_long,
  aes(x = datetime, y = Discharge, color = Mountain_Side)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Window, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Scarp" = "#6B5A8E",
      "Dip"   = "#C76A2A"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Discharge Comparison",
    x = "",
    y = "Discharge (mm/day)"
  ) +
  poster_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(fig_discharge)
```
Conc. Plots
```{r}
data <- read_csv("data/MDH_Beast_AllChem_Apr22.csv") %>%
  filter(!Site %in% c("MSL", "MSTR1", "MSU", "RT0")) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = mdy(Date),
    Reach = recode(Reach,
      "Beast" = "Scarp",
      "MDH"   = "Dip"
    )
  )

elements <- read_csv("data/Periodic Table of Elements.csv") %>% 
  select(Symbol, AtomicMass)

data_long <- data %>% 
  select(Date, Site, Reach, Dist, Na_ppb, Mg_ppb, 
         Al_ppb, Si_ppb, K_ppb, Ca_ppb, Fe_ppb,
         S_ppm_as_SO4) %>%
  pivot_longer(Na_ppb:S_ppm_as_SO4) %>%
  mutate(Element = substr(name, 1, nchar(name) - 4)) %>%
  left_join(elements, by = c("Element" = "Symbol")) %>%
  mutate(mol_L = (value / 1000000) / AtomicMass)

data_long %>% 
  filter(name %in% c("Ca_ppb","K_ppb","Mg_ppb","Si_ppb","Na_ppb")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dist, y = value, color = Reach, shape = factor(Date))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(vars(name), scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Scarp" = "#9B8AB9",
      "Dip"   = "#E39A63"
    ),
    name = "Streams"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

Three Regions Plot
```{r}
data_wide_molL <- data_long %>%
  select(Site, Date, Reach, Dist, Element, mol_L) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = mol_L, names_from = Element)

regions <- data.frame(
  region = c("Evaporites", "Silicates", "Carbonates"),
  xmin = c(0.12, 0.22, 20),
  xmax = c(0.28, 0.65, 80),
  ymin = c(0.015, 0.18, 6),
  ymax = c(0.05, 0.65, 10)
)

data_wide_molL <- data_wide_molL %>%
  mutate(Reach = recode(Reach,
    "Beast" = "Scarp",
    "MDH"   = "Dip"
  ))

data_wide_molL %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Ca / Na, y = Mg / Na, color = Reach)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_rect(
    data = regions,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
        fill = region),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = regions,
    aes(x = sqrt(xmin * xmax),
        y = sqrt(ymin * ymax),
        label = region),
    size = 5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Scarp" = "#9B8AB9",
      "Dip"   = "#E39A63"
    ),
    name = "Streams"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    name = "Ca/Na",
    limits = c(0.1, 100)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    name = "Mg/Na",
    limits = c(0.01, 10)
  )
```
